services.name: American Medical Response Northwest (AMR)
services.area: single county ASA (whole county except the slivers below)
services.evidence: The Washington County ASA Plan (ASP) designates the county as a single ambulance service area (ASA). The ASA is awarded to a single emergency ambulance service provider in the form of a franchise. | EMS Strategic Plan 2026-2030: "In August of 2023, the Washington County EMS program entered into a franchise agreement with American Medical Response (AMR)"; county EMS page: "one emergency ambulance company, seven fire department first response agencies"
services.vintage: 2023 plan; 2026 strategic plan; July 2026 AMR performance report

41067.page_note: American Medical Response (AMR) holds Washington County's emergency ambulance franchise for the county's single ambulance service area; the fire departments respond first but do not hold it. The Washington County parts of Wilsonville, Lake Oswego and Rivergrove are served from Clackamas County, and the area south of Bell Road and Highway 99W is in Tualatin Valley Fire & Rescue's Yamhill County service area; who transports in those small areas is not yet confirmed.

services.name: American Medical Response Northwest (AMR)
services.area: Clackamas ASA (Hoodland, Estacada, Sandy, Clackamas Fire districts, Gladstone, Lake Oswego, TVF&R area)
services.evidence: American Medical Response Northwest, Inc. was assigned as the provider for the Clackamas ASA in a competitive process under the 1993 Ambulance Service Plan. (County Code 10.01, amended by Ord. 04-2024, 11/14/24); county EMS page: "Emergency Medical Services (EMS) in Clackamas County are provided under contract by American Medical Response (AMR) and local fire agencies"

services.name: Canby Fire District
services.evidence: The Canby Rural Fire Protection District was assigned as the provider for the Canby ASA under the 1991 Ambulance Service Plan and will continue to provide service to that area.

services.name: Molalla Fire District
services.area: Molalla ASA (Molalla, Colton, Clackamas parts of Monitor and Silverton districts)
services.evidence: The Molalla Rural Fire Protection District (RFPD) was assigned as the provider for the Molalla ASA under the 1991 Ambulance Service Plan and will continue to provide service to that area.

41005.page_note: Clackamas County has three ambulance service areas under its 2024 county code: American Medical Response (most of the county), Canby Fire District (Canby area) and Molalla Fire District (Molalla area). Not yet confirmed: whether Lake Oswego Fire Department carries patients in Lake Oswego, and which agency serves the edge areas the county plan routes to Woodburn Ambulance Service.

services.name: American Medical Response (AMR)
services.evidence: A single franchised provider—American Medical Response, Inc. (AMR)—provides all of Multnomah County's ambulance services. ... The team that arrives first starts medical care, and the ambulance team transports patients to the hospital.

41051.page_note: American Medical Response holds Multnomah County's single 911 ambulance contract, which runs through August 31, 2028. Not yet confirmed: whether neighbouring agencies that answer calls at the county's edges under agreements, such as Cascade Locks Fire & EMS in the eastern Columbia River Gorge and the area along Highway 30 next to Columbia County, also carry patients from those areas.
41051.second_source: https://multco.us/file/multnomah_county_ems_services_assessment_report_-_february_17,_2026/download (Feb 2026 county EMS assessment: AMR dispatcher at BOEC, AMR low-acuity triage and BLS units; draft ASA plan June 2026: 'All of Multnomah County comprises a single ambulance service area (ASA).'); county contract history (docs.google.com/document/d/13DRZ2mAN32DV5i7cNd2opjsRPiKdnaYd-QEgwr8sfVg, linked from multco.us EMS page): 2018 contract Amendment #2 extended termination to August 31, 2028; draft ASP June 2026 lists out-of-county IGA areas (Dunthorpe, Lake Oswego portions, Hwy 30 near Columbia County, eastern areas next to Clackamas and Hood River counties)

41017.page_note: Deschutes County assigns emergency ambulance service by area (county code 8.30, terms through June 30, 2028). Confirmed: Bend Fire & Rescue, Redmond Fire & Rescue, Sisters-Camp Sherman, La Pine, Sunriver, Black Butte Ranch and Crooked River Ranch fire agencies, plus Alfalfa Fire District, which began its own ambulance transports in 2025 under an agreement with Bend Fire. Not yet confirmed: the small far-eastern corner of the county (near Hampton) that the county map assigns to the Burns ambulance area in Harney County.
41017.second_source: https://ktvz.com/news/government-politics/2026/06/30/commitment-to-serve-alfalfa-fire-district-pushes-forward-amid-challenges/ (Alfalfa Fire still operating, June 2026); county ASA page https://www.deschutescounty.gov/985/Ambulance-Service-Area

41011.page_note: Coos County has six ambulance service areas held by five services: Bay Cities Ambulance (Coos Bay and North Bend areas), Coquille Valley Ambulance, Myrtle Point Ambulance, Powers Ambulance, and Lower Umpqua Hospital EMS (northern Coos County). Bay Cities Ambulance and Lower Umpqua Hospital EMS are confirmed by their own websites; the Coquille, Myrtle Point and Powers services are not yet confirmed by a recent source.

41059.page_note: Umatilla County has six ambulance service areas (county map, June 2026): Pendleton, Hermiston/Umatilla, Milton-Freewater, Mill Creek (served from Walla Walla), Athena/Weston, and the Confederated Tribes of the Umatilla Indian Reservation. The service running each area is not yet confirmed by a recent source.

41043.page_note: Linn County's ambulance service area map (August 2026) names areas for Albany, Lebanon, Sweet Home, Santiam, Lyons, Jefferson, Idanha/Detroit, Corvallis, Sisters, Eugene and Springfield. Which of these reach into Linn County and the service running each are not yet confirmed by a recent source.
